text: There is an air of anticipation in this place, a modern building with glass walls and meticulously placed objects. The first room is empty but prepared, as if awaiting an imminent gathering of minds. Entering the second scene, I’m greeted by bold, vibrant visuals and reflective words about research and development. I feel curious and invigorated, as though I stand on the threshold of innovation and collective curiosity. A sense of possibility hums beneath the surface—what will I learn here, and how might it change me?
